p.i: Cuius tamen generis malignitas tua plu-ribus quoque detecta per nos non sciscitabulo solum, ac prologo belli Allatiani de Papissa alibi-que, verum & pastillo quo te locupletatum a me nosti, ut odorem tuis adspiret naribus.

main_text.head: JOANNES HENRICUS BOECLERUS In Commentario de rebus seculi a Christo nato IX. & X. per seriem Germanorum Caesarum.

p.i: Eos qui negaverunt Joannam Papissam foeminam recenset, numeroque accedit Baronius: Adduntur Leo Allatius, & Davit Blondellus.

main_text.head: CLAUDIUS SARAVIUS Senator Parisiensis Epistola ad Vincentium Fabrum scripta Anno 1640. pag.41.

p.i: De Salmasio. De primatu Papa, prolixum opus mouet, centum puta, & amplius Quaternionum cum duabus Appendicibus de Antichristo, & de Joanna Papissa, in priore Pontificios κἀ ἰσως τὸν πάνυ Γρώπον[?]: in posteriore Leonem Allatium, & Davidem Blon-

page.notes: The Greek phrase in the first appendix is small and partly blurred: the opening word may be κἀ or καὶ, and the final word "Γρώπον" is doubtful, marked [?]. The long s is printed as f in "sciscitabulo" and "pastillo"; transcribed as s. Headings converted per u/v rule: CLAUDIUS, SARAVIUS, BOECLERUS, HENRICUS, Joannam, Davit/Davidem. The text ends mid-word at "Blon-"; the word continues on the next page. The leftmost strip of the scan shows show-through and edge marks, which were omitted.
